notes.title: Mostly some bug fixes...
notes.notes:
2.26.206 - June 18, 2021
BUG FIXES:
• Fixed bug where the new "Auto-Discover Locations" option wouldn't work unless you unchecked and re-checked it after launching the game each time.
• Fixed bug that prevented entering small venues when you have a custom band t-shirt design that has 0 distributed.
• Fixed pathfinding bug from Duluth, MN area to nearby areas west of that, which were resulting in travel times that were longer than intended.
• Fixed bug that was preventing contract reputation value from saving if greater than 0, making it reset to 0 when reloading the game. This negatively affected your chances for getting recording contracts.
• Fixed bug that was miscalculating your band's average popularity per city in a given region so that it was lower than it should be. This negatively affected your chances for getting recording contracts.
• Fixed bug in photo studio that wasn't properly updating musician controls when moving them to different spots.
• Fixed issue where you could click wall items in homes, hotels/motels, and art galleries if they were behind the foreground UI elements, making the UI elements unresponsive.
MISCELLANEOUS:
• Changed popularity display during gigs to show the regional total instead of world total. For example it is now (city popularity / region popularity) instead of (city popularity / world popularity) since world popularity total isn't really used for anything.
• Changed patron names to be two columns instead of one on the "About" dialog.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to the players that sent me their save game files to investigate issues they've experienced. I was able to fix a couple of issues in this update.

1. Setting Greensboro, North Carolina as the tour start city would result in eventual crashes.
2. Rarely, somehow the manager associated with a recording contract would get disassociated, so the game would crash when trying to pay the (missing) manager for CD sales royalties.

https://youtu.be/81LvZovsY_M

notes.title: Major Game Balance Update, and Much More!
notes.notes:
In addition, the update includes many small bug fixes and quality-of-life enhancements.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vGcSu9mJqs

- Balance tweaks:
	- Fixed label-based CD sales, which was using the wrong calculation to determine sales.
	- Gig-based CD and T-Shirt sales. Less CD sales, more T-Shirt sales.
	- Gig flat-rate gig pay in theaters and arenas (more appropriate for your popularity).
	- Song popularity gain during gigs (lowered). Song popularity now primarily comes from distributed CD's.
	- Recording costs and requirements for contracts, including a required producer for initial major contracts.
	- Larger recording contracts now have longer deadlines.
	- Smaller record labels have even easier requirements to get a contract, larger labels have even harder requirements.
	- Song idea values, making it harder to get really good ideas.
	- No longer reduce band popularity when a member leaves the band.
	- Doubled the amount of happiness & inspiration gained from trashing hotels.
	- Inspiration and happiness gain from gigs - less is gained when playing several shows in a row without days off.
- Added busking feature, and a few instruments specifically used for busking. Busking can be done in mowed parks.
- Added naming of tours.
- Added upcoming gigs list, accessible from the personal calendar. List includes the tour name that each gig is part of, if part of a tour.
- Added ability to rename a song.
- Up to 10 song ideas can now be banked so they aren't forgotten after 14 days.
- No longer increase song quality during practice. The final quality is what it was at writing time.
- Songs can now be re-recorded at higher quality levels than previous recordings.
- Option to disable musician compatibilities changing over time. This is a temporary fix until a new feature is introduced.
- Added confirmation dialog to do things that would pass time and cause you to miss a gig.
- Fixed bug that could result in negative t-shirt sales.
- Fixed bug that prevented other bands from watching your gigs to support your band.
- Fixed bug with overlapping art appearing on the art screen when choosing what to hang in your home.
- Fixed bug preventing banners from appearing in theater and arena gigs.
- Fixed bug where the theater or arena calendar button would be stuck on when chauffering away from them.
- Fixed bug where adjusting venue reputation was adjusting the city reputation by the incorrect amount.
- Improved error-handling when trying to load bad external soundtrack file.
- Non-musician NPC's will no longer wear spandex pants.
- Male NPC's will no longer wear the high-heel boots.
- Added "Bought for: $X" text to equipment details, to show how much was paid for equipment.
- Slight improvements to equipment repair UI.

notes.title: Bug fix for double-booked gigs
notes.notes:
A bug was reported by a couple of players, where they couldn't get past a certain date in the game, and it was related to having two gigs booked on the same date, which should never happen. It confused the game into knowing what gig to do on that date. This always happens with one of the dates being a tour gig.

The update fixes the double-booked date by discarding the non-tour gig date and keeping the tour gig when loading the game. Also, a fix was put in the avoid the double-bookings in the future.

Here's how I think it was happening...
1. You have your manager set to book a tour.
2. NPC bands start booking their gigs. While doing this they also look to see if the player's band would fit into the gig as an opening slot. This will only happen if the player's band doesn't yet have a gig on the same date. If everything looks good, schedule a phone call to ask the player if he wants the gig.
3. The manager books tour gigs. However, one of these tour gig dates is the same date that the phone call from #2 is on.
4. The player gets the phone call inviting them to the gig, because when the phone call was scheduled, the date was free, but now it's not. The player clicks Yes and the double-booking happens.

Thanks to everyone that has bought the game already, and thank you very much for your patience with any bugs you encounter. I can usually fix the bug if I get the save game files that are affected, such as in this case.
